example_prompts: Make generative art inspired by ocean currents, with sliders for speed and colour.
Create a flow-field piece I can re-seed until I like it, then save as a PNG.
Make an animated particle piece for my band's album art, neon pink and electric blue on black, with a seed button so I can find my favourite version.
Make a calm, minimal generative piece inspired by tide pools, and let me flip through different seeds.
